summary: This intake log centralizes GPU capacity requests across infra and product teams for Q3 2026. Each row is an intake ticket; owners should keep the primary_contact updated and attach the linked_jira where available. Use this sheet to coordinate regional placement, instance-family constraints, and approval handoffs.
approval_workflow: 1) Team fills intake row and attaches Jira. 2) infra-pm triages for fit (sizing, region). 3) Capacity Committee (weekly) reviews P0/P1 and issues provisional allocations. 4) Finance approves cost > $10k. 5) Final approver (head-of-infra or head-of-private) signs off for reserved pools.
